reviews.title: Solid performance and simple installation.
reviews.comment: Purchased these for a gaming system build about a year ago.  They have been running 8+ hours a day since with no issues whatsoever.  The ARGB lights are bright, and the fans provide plenty of airflow for adequate cooling of my system.  Wiring was easy with plenty of cable.  Excellent value.
reviews.author: Glen Charron Jr.

reviews.title: Great fans, high speeds, low noise
reviews.comment:
My first original order was working perfectly, after a while 2 fans starting sounding bad, got in contact with customer service and they were excellent in support.
Will buy 2 more sets to complete my setup since i have other brands mixed in and i want to take full advantage of the reversed ones they sell,.
Dont be fooled by the price they are on special now and work great.
reviews.author: Ulloa Center

reviews.title: Buy these fans!
reviews.comment: The fans look great, connect easily, and move a lot of air. The lights are bright and match my other RGB. Great value for what you get.
reviews.author: Rob B.

reviews.title: Ventiladores delanteros de buena calidad a pesar de su precio
reviews.comment:
Para empezar los ventiladores son bastantes silenciosos aunque bueno se nota algo de ruido si ya los ubicas entre 6 a 9 ventiladores, cumplen con su objetivo de mantener una presión de aire tanto neutral como positiva por otro lado las luces argb son algo limitadas en colores pero bueno tampoco se puede exigir mucho por el hecho de que son un producto barato, otro lado que también hay que ver es que sus conexiones de margarita son algo sensibles en mi caso yo tuve un problema con uno de los pines del conector que da poder a todos los ventiladores en cadena pero súper enderezar el pin actualmente me funcionan bien no he tenido mayores problemas con ellos
Puntuación: 8/10
Razón: problema al momento de instalación
reviews.author: Victor Rivadeneira

reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: Easy install, quite, and look awesome. And for the price I’m impressed.
reviews.author: Sterling
